scoring_criteria.1: Head tracks ring but not for a complete trial.
scoring_criteria.0: Head does not track ring.

fine_motor.note: Ring with string items are also in the Cognitive subtest.

scoring_criteria.2: Eyes track pencil through 1 complete trial.
scoring_criteria.1: Eyes track pencil but not for a complete trial.
scoring_criteria.0: Eyes do not track pencil.

2.description: Holds both hands open almost all of the time.

1.description: Holds both hands open some of the time.

0.description: One or both hands remain fisted most of the time or cortical thumbing is noted at least some of the time.

fine_motor.caregiver_question: When [insert child's name] is not holding something, are [his/her] hands open almost all the time, some of the time, or none of the time?

scoring_criteria.2: Hands do not reflexively close when palms are gently pressed.
scoring_criteria.1: Hands close briefly but then open and grasp is loose.
scoring_criteria.0: Hands reflexively close when palms are gently pressed and grasp is tight for several seconds.

fine_motor.material: Block, rattle, bell, or other small object

scoring_criteria.2: Freely rotates wrist from palm down to palm up.
scoring_criteria.1: Slightly rotates wrist.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not rotate wrist.

2.description: Uses 1 or both hands to successfully grasp ring.

1.description: Attempts to grasp ring with 1 or both hands but only makes contact.

0.description: Does not reach for ring or attempts to touch ring are unsuccessful.

fine_motor.caregiver_question: Is [insert child's name] able to successfully grab things that hang, like this ring (point to ring), almost every time [he/she] tries, some of the time, or none of the time?
fine_motor.note: Ring with string items are also in the Cognitive subtest.

2.description: Extends 1 or both arms and touches block.

1.description: Extends 1 or both arms but does not touch block.

0.description: Does not reach for block.

fine_motor.caregiver_question: When things like this block (point to block) are placed in front of [insert child's name], is [he/she] able to reach for and touch them almost every time [he/she] tries, some of the time, or none of the time?

scoring_criteria.2: Grasps block using 1 hand with whole hand (palmar) grasp or uses more advanced grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Grasps block using both hands.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not grasp block.

scoring_criteria.2: Looks at pellet for at least 3 seconds.
scoring_criteria.1: Looks at pellet for less than 3 seconds and does not focus on it.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not regard pellet.

scoring_criteria.2: Grasps pellet using whole hand grasp or uses more advanced grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Inconsistently uses whole hand grasp or uses raking grasp.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not attempt to grasp pellet.

scoring_criteria.2: Transfers block (not ring) from hand to hand.
scoring_criteria.1: Transfers ring (not block) from hand to hand.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not transfer ring or block from hand to hand.

fine_motor.note: Ring with string items are also in the Cognitive subtest.

2.description: Almost every time
2.example: Successfully picks up small foods with thumb and finger and puts them in mouth

1.description: Some of the time
1.example: Attempts to pick up small foods but not consistently successful

0.description: None of the time
0.example: Does not successfully pick up small foods

fine_motor.caregiver_question: When you give [insert child's name] small foods, like peas, puffs, or raisins, is [he/she] able to successfully pick them up with [his/her] thumb and finger and put them in [his/her] mouth almost every time [he/she] tries, some of the time, or none of the time?

scoring_criteria.2: Grasps block using thumb-fingertip grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Grasps block using partial thumb opposition grasp.
scoring_criteria.0: Uses less advanced grasp.

scoring_criteria.2: Grasps pellet using neat pincer grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Grasps pellet using partial thumb opposition grasp.
scoring_criteria.0: Uses less advanced grasp.

2.description: Consistently and successfully attempts to turn 1 page at a time

1.description: Occasionally turns 1 page at a time but typically turns several pages

0.description: Does not attempt to turn pages

fine_motor.caregiver_question: Is [insert child's name] able to successfully turn the pages of a book one at a time almost every time [he/she] turns pages, some of the time, or none of the time?

scoring_criteria.2: Grasps crayon or pencil using palmar grasp (palmar supinate or radial cross palmar) and makes a mark on paper or uses more advanced grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Grasps crayon or pencil using fingers and thumb opposition but does not make a mark.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not grasp crayon or pencil firmly in palm.

scoring_criteria.2: Intentionally pokes a finger or thumb in at least 2 holes.
scoring_criteria.1: Intentionally pokes a finger or thumb in 1 hole or pokes a finger or thumb repeatedly in the same hole.
scoring_criteria.0: Shows no interest in pegboard or does not poke a finger into any holes.

scoring_criteria.2: Spontaneously and purposely scribbles on paper.
scoring_criteria.1: Purposely scribbles on paper after demonstration.
scoring_criteria.0: Accidentally marks on paper while playing with crayon or does not mark on paper.

scoring_criteria.2: Stacks 2 to 12 blocks in any trial.
scoring_criteria.1: Stacks 2 blocks but does not leave them stacked, does not release second block, or blocks fall over.
scoring_criteria.0: Base is not a single block or does not stack blocks.

scoring_criteria.2: Places 10 pellets in bottle within 60 seconds, 1 at a time.
scoring_criteria.1: Places 5 to 9 pellets in bottle within 60 seconds, 1 at a time.
scoring_criteria.0: Places 0 to 4 pellets in bottle within 60 seconds, 1 at a time.

scoring_criteria.2: Consistently grasps crayon or pencil using transitional grasp (digital pronate) and makes a mark on paper or uses more advanced grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Inconsistently uses transitional grasp and marks on paper.
scoring_criteria.0: Uses less advanced grasp.

scoring_criteria.2: Places 4 to 7 coins in slot within 90 seconds.
scoring_criteria.1: Places 3 coins in slot within 90 seconds.
scoring_criteria.0: Places 0 to 2 coins in slot within 90 seconds.

scoring_criteria.2: Separates all stacked blocks.
scoring_criteria.1: Separates at least 1 block from stacked blocks.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not separate any stacked blocks.

scoring_criteria.2: Consistently grasps crayon or pencil using static tripod grasp or static quadrupod grasp and makes a mark on paper or uses more advanced grasp.
scoring_criteria.1: Inconsistently uses static tripod grasp or static quadrupod and marks on paper.
scoring_criteria.0: Uses less advanced grasp.

scoring_criteria.2: Stacks 6 to 12 blocks in any trial.
scoring_criteria.1: Stacks 4 to 5 blocks in any trial.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not stack at least 4 blocks in any trial or uses 2 or more blocks as the base.

scoring_criteria.2: Makes both horizontal and vertical strokes that are within approximately 30° of your lines.
scoring_criteria.1: Makes either a horizontal or vertical stroke that is within approximately 30° of your lines.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not make horizontal or vertical strokes or neither stroke is within 30° of your lines.

scoring_criteria.2: Puts all 6 blocks together within 90 seconds.
scoring_criteria.1: Puts 3 to 5 blocks together within 90 seconds.
scoring_criteria.0: Puts 0 to 2 blocks together within 90 seconds.

scoring_criteria.2: Stacks 8 to 12 blocks in any trial.
scoring_criteria.1: Stacks 7 blocks in any trial.
scoring_criteria.0: Does not stack at least 7 blocks in any trial or uses 2 or more blocks as the base.

2.description: Consistently grasps crayon or pencil using mature, controlled, dynamic grasp and makes a mark on paper.

1.description: Inconsistently uses dynamic grasp and marks on paper.

0.description: Uses less advanced grasp.

2.description: Takes at least 4 steps with support with good coordination.

1.description: Takes at least 2 steps with support with good coordination or more than 2 steps without good coordination.

0.description: Does not take any steps or relies completely on support to move forward.

2.description: Takes at least 5 steps without support with good coordination and without using arms for balance.

1.description: Takes at least 3 steps without support but without good coordination and uses arms for balance (e.g., medium or high guard).

0.description: Does not take at least 3 steps without support, gait is asymmetric, or does not attempt to walk.

gross_motor.item_description: Walks Up Stairs Series: Both Feet on Each Step Without Support

2.description: Walks up at least 3 steps without support, placing both feet on each step before stepping up to the next.

1.description: Walks up at least 3 steps with support, placing both feet on each step before stepping up to the next.

0.description: Does not walk up at least 3 steps.

2.description: Takes at least 3 steps backward without support and shows good balance.

1.description: Takes 2 steps backward without support; slight loss of balance acceptable.

0.description: Does not take at least 2 steps backward without support or walks backward and loses balance after 1 to 2 steps.

gross_motor.item_description: Walks Down Stairs Series: Both Feet on Each Step Without Support

2.description: Walks down at least 3 steps without support, placing both feet on each step before stepping down to the next.

1.description: Walks down at least 3 steps with support, placing both feet on each step before stepping down to the next.

0.description: Does not walk down at least 3 steps.

2.description: Runs with good coordination.

1.description: Runs but is slightly uncoordinated or a bit stiff.

0.description: Runs with uneven gait, with legs spread more than shoulder width apart or child trips; arms might posture or 1 or both hands fist.

gross_motor.item_description: Balances on Each Foot With Support

2.description: Balances on both left and right foot with support for at least 2 seconds.

1.description: Balances on only right or only left foot with support for at least 2 seconds.

0.description: Does not balance on either foot for at least 2 seconds or balances on either foot but requires support beyond just holding child's hand.

2.description: Jumps to floor with feet together and both feet are in the air at some point during jump, and lands with balance.

1.description: Jumps to floor with 1 foot leading and both feet are in the air at some point during jump, but does not land with balance.

0.description: Does not jump to floor or jumps up but lands on same step, or walks down step rather than jumping.

gross_motor.caregiver_question: Does [insert child's name] jump from the bottom step and land without stumbling or falling down almost every time [he/she] tries, some of the time, or none of the time?

2.description: Maintains balance while kicking ball in a forward direction at least 2 ft.

1.description: Kicks ball, but it moves forward less than 2 ft or child loses balance in the process of kicking.

0.description: Makes kicking motion but misses ball, or kicks ball but requires support to maintain balance.

2.description: Takes at least 2 steps with both feet on stepping path and keeps 1 foot on path for at least 5 ft.

1.description: Walks for at least 5 ft and keeps at least 1 foot on stepping path.

0.description: Does not keep 1 foot on stepping path or does not walk a distance of at least 5 ft.

2.description: Jumps at least 6 in. for any trial.

1.description: Jumps 1 to 5 in. for any trial.

0.description: Does not jump any distance for any trial.

2.description: Jumps off floor with feet together or leads with 1 foot and both feet are in the air at some point during the jump.

1.description: Jumps but only 1 foot is in the air.

0.description: Bends legs in an attempt to jump, but both feet remain in contact with floor.

gross_motor.caregiver_question: Is [insert child's name] able to jump off the floor with both feet in the air at the same time almost every time [he/she] tries, some of the time, or none of the time?

gross_motor.item_description: Balances on Each Foot Without Support Series: 2 Seconds

2.description: Balances on both left and right foot without support for at least 2 seconds.

1.description: Balances on only right or only left foot without support for at least 2 seconds.

0.description: Does not balance on either foot for at least 2 seconds or requires support to maintain balance.

2.description: Takes at least 4 steps without touching heels to floor.

1.description: Takes 1 to 3 steps without touching heels to floor.

0.description: Does not take any steps without touching heels to floor.

2.description: Walks backward within approximately 6 in. of stepping path for at least 5 ft.

1.description: Walks backward close to path for several steps.

0.description: Stumbles walking backward, requires support, or cannot walk backward.

gross_motor.item_description: Walks Up Stairs Series: Alternating Feet Without Support

2.description: Walks up at least 3 steps without support, alternating feet on each step.

1.description: Walks up 2 steps without support, alternating feet on each step.

0.description: Does not walk up at least 2 steps without support, alternating feet on each step.

2.description: Stops in a controlled fashion within 2 steps of end of stepping path on either trial.

1.description: Stops within 3 or more steps of end of stepping path on either trial; might stumble at end.

0.description: Does not stop at end of stepping path, stops by sitting down or squatting, or loses balance when attempting to stop.

gross_motor.item_description: Walks Down Stairs Series: Alternating Feet Without Support

2.description: Walks down at least 3 steps without support, alternating feet on each step.

1.description: Walks down 2 steps without support, alternating feet on each step.

0.description: Does not walk down at least 2 steps without support, alternating feet on each step.

2.description: Hops on 1 foot for a distance of at least 5 ft.

1.description: Hops on 1 foot several times but less than 5 ft.

0.description: Hops in place, stumbles, or does not hop.

gross_motor.item_description: Balances on Each Foot Without Support Series: 6 Seconds

2.description: Balances on both left and right foot without support for at least 6 seconds.

1.description: Balances on only right or only left foot without support for at least 6 seconds.

0.description: Does not balance on either foot for at least 6 seconds or requires support to maintain balance.

2.description: Completes at least 6 heel-to-toe steps for either trial.

1.description: Completes 4 to 5 heel-to-toe steps for either trial.

0.description: Does not complete at least 4 heel-to-toe steps for either trial.

2.description: Jumps at least 24 in. for any trial.

1.description: Jumps 12 to 23 in. for any trial.

0.description: Does not jump at least 12 in. for any trial.
